title: Refresh candidate evidence when the target branch moves
summary: Bind hardening review evidence to the current PR base, head, merge checkout and tree. Recheck the combined Lydite and Veraphify workflows before relying on the candidate for an owner decision.
benefits: The owner can review evidence for the proposed integration tree.
risks: Separate greens for the old candidate and later main leave the combined tree unverified.
A routine run and a named release receipt represent different events in the review.

evidence.claim: The candidate review requires the selected release checkout, matching receipt and owner decision.
